# Mac PDF Editor

> Free, open-source, cross-platform desktop PDF editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux built with Tauri v2 (Rust), React, PDF.js, pdf-lib, lopdf, and offline Apple Vision OCR.

- Repository: https://github.com/document-software/mac-pdf-editor
- Website: https://document-software.github.io/mac-pdf-editor/
- License: MIT
- App Size: ~6 MB native binary

## Core Capabilities
- Edit existing PDF text with bounding-box sizing and automatic background color sampling (`sampleBackgroundColor`)
- Offline macOS Vision OCR (`VNRecognizeTextRequest`, English + Cyrillic) for scanned PDFs
- Highlight, draw freehand signatures, insert PNG/JPG stamps, whiteout/redact regions
- Reorder, rotate (90°), duplicate, delete, split, and merge PDF pages
- Compress PDFs via Rust `lopdf` (`prune_objects` + `compress`)
- Export annotated pages to PNG
- Local HTTP Control API (`127.0.0.1:4890`) and stdio MCP server (`mcp/server.mjs`)
